connection_condition: schools carry the district code in tb003.cl0041 and district name in tb003.cl0045
description: A district is composed of multiple schools; a school record belongs to one district.

connection_condition: county name is repeated on each school row alongside the district name
description: Districts are located within counties, but the county is a label on school records rather than a separate district entity.

connection_condition: rate is free meal eligible count divided by enrollment for the same age base
description: The eligible free rate is computed from free meal count and enrollment.

connection_condition: rate is the count of test takers scoring 1500 or above divided by total test takers
description: The excellence rate is derived from SAT test takers and the count scoring 1500 or above.

connection_condition: cards carry a set code that matches sets.cl0169
description: An expansion set is composed of card printings.

connection_condition: localized rows share the card id and card uuid with the primary card row
description: A localized printing expresses the same card in another language; the primary and localized rows are alternative representations of one card.

connection_condition: legalities rows reference the card id and add a format and legality status
description: Format legality records are component records of a card.

connection_condition: transactions carry the customer identifier
description: A customer is composed of their card transactions.

connection_condition: transactions carry the gas station identifier
description: A gas station is composed of the transactions made there.

connection_condition: transactions carry the product identifier
description: A product is composed of the transactions that purchase it.

connection_condition: monthly consumption aggregates transaction amounts per customer and month
description: Monthly consumption is derived from a customer's transactions for a month.

connection_condition: accounts carry a district identifier
description: A district is composed of the accounts opened in it.

connection_condition: the disposition table links clients to accounts
description: A client holds accounts through disposition records.

connection_condition: loans carry the account identifier
description: An account is composed of its loans.

connection_condition: transactions carry the account identifier
description: An account is composed of its transactions.

connection_condition: average salary is a district-level attribute stored on the district row
description: The average salary is a district characteristic used to characterize its residents.

connection_condition: results carry the race identifier
description: A race is composed of its driver results.

connection_condition: results carry the driver identifier
description: A driver participates in races through result rows.

connection_condition: results carry the constructor identifier
description: A constructor participates in races through result rows.

connection_condition: lap times carry the race identifier and driver identifier
description: A race is composed of individual lap times.

connection_condition: standings aggregate result points and wins per driver and race
description: Driver championship standings are derived from race results.

connection_condition: standings aggregate result points and wins per constructor and race
description: Constructor championship standings are derived from race results.

connection_condition: forename and surname are separate columns on the driver row
description: A driver full name is formed from the forename and surname.

connection_condition: attendance rows carry the event identifier
description: An event is composed of attendance links to members.

connection_condition: attendance rows carry the member identifier
description: A member participates in events through attendance links.

connection_condition: members carry a major reference
description: A member studies an academic major with a department and college.

connection_condition: expense rows carry the budget identifier
description: A budget category is composed of member expense lines.

connection_condition: income rows carry the member identifier
description: Income records such as dues are associated with the paying member.

connection_condition: first name and last name are separate columns
description: A member full name is formed from first name and last name.

connection_condition: hero power links carry the hero identifier
description: A superhero is composed of links to its superpowers.

connection_condition: hero power links carry the power identifier
description: A superpower is associated with heroes through hero power links.

connection_condition: hero attribute rows carry the hero identifier
description: A superhero is composed of scored attribute values.

connection_condition: hero attribute rows carry the attribute identifier
description: An attribute is associated with heroes through attribute value rows.

connection_condition: eye, hair and skin references all resolve to the same colour lookup table
description: Eye, hair and skin colour attributes share one colour value domain.

connection_condition: examination rows carry the patient identifier
description: A patient is composed of clinical examinations.

connection_condition: laboratory rows carry the patient identifier
description: A patient is composed of laboratory test sessions.

connection_condition: laboratory measurements are columns of a test session row
description: A laboratory test session is composed of individual measurements.

connection_condition: age is the difference between the current year and the birth year
description: Patient age is derived from the birth date and the current date.

connection_condition: atoms carry the molecule identifier
description: A molecule is composed of atoms.

connection_condition: bonds carry the molecule identifier
description: A molecule is composed of bonds.

connection_condition: atom-bond links carry the bond identifier
description: A bond is composed of connections to the atoms it joins.
